atomic_propositions.name: enter_loiter_at_home
atomic_propositions.controlled_natural_language: RTL 进入 Home 上方等待子状态。
atomic_propositions.truth_condition: 内部 RTL sub-state 的进入边沿。
atomic_propositions.validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
atomic_propositions.freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
atomic_propositions.scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: State-machine transition call after RETURN_HOME reports complete.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 138-150 dispatch loiterathome_start when _state_complete is true in RETURN_HOME. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L148

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Canonical internal sub-state write for entering the Home loiter stage.
source_bindings.evidence: loiterathome_start writes the state and clears _state_complete. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L258

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Autopilot monotonic-boot epoch for this LOITER_AT_HOME entry.
source_bindings.evidence: The timer is initialized in the same function immediately after the state write. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L260

mavlink_observations.derivation: Confirms coarse RTL mode only. HEARTBEAT has no embedded timestamp.

atomic_propositions.name: rtl_loiter_eligible
atomic_propositions.controlled_natural_language: 本次 RTL 持续选择最终下降路径且未被取消。
atomic_propositions.truth_condition: 在所检查时间范围内 RTL 和 landing-path eligibility 均持续为 true。
atomic_propositions.validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
atomic_propositions.freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
atomic_propositions.scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Internal RTL state enum and current-state field; LOITER_AT_HOME is the timed stage.
source_bindings.evidence: mode.h:1534-1542 defines enum/accessor and mode.h:1603 stores _state. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L1534

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Path-selection field: true chooses direct landing after loiter; false permits FINAL_DESCENT when radio failsafe is also false.
source_bindings.evidence: build_path derives land from runtime RTL_ALT_FINAL_M. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L462

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Transition guard selecting LAND versus FINAL_DESCENT after Home loiter completes.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 151-156 call land_start on true and descent_start on false. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L152

source_bindings.semantic_identity: RTL run stops state progression when motors are not armed.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 132-136 return immediately when disarmed. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L134

mavlink_observations.derivation: Confirms coarse RTL mode only. HEARTBEAT has no embedded timestamp.

atomic_propositions.name: begin_final_descent
atomic_propositions.truth_condition: 内部 RTL sub-state 进入 final descent 的边沿。
atomic_propositions.validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
atomic_propositions.freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
atomic_propositions.scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: After elapsed RTL_LOIT_TIME and yaw-reset completion, sets _state_complete true.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 294-304 compare elapsed time with runtime rtl_loiter_time and complete the stage. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L294

source_bindings.semantic_identity: State-machine producer chosen when Home loiter is complete, rtl_path.land is false, and radio failsafe is false.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 151-156 choose between land_start and descent_start. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L155

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Canonical internal sub-state write for final descent start.
source_bindings.evidence: descent_start writes FINAL_DESCENT, clears completion, and initializes vertical/yaw controllers. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L311

mavlink_observations.derivation: Confirms coarse RTL mode only. HEARTBEAT has no embedded timestamp.
